name: Developer Product Launch & Tech Showcase
description: High-energy, hyper-relatable developer cinema showcasing painful production bugs, terminal flow states, and the sheer elegance of great developer tools.

language.tone: Punchy, witty, authentic dev culture, zero corporate fluff
language.guidelines: Reference real dev pain: yaml indentation hell, midnight on-call pager alarms, 200MB docker containers, local env discrepancies.

narrativeThemes: The 2 AM Production Bug Pager Nightmare
Legacy Spaghetti Code vs The Elegant Clean Architecture
Localhost Works Perfectly, But Kubernetes Replicas Crash
The 10x Engineer Who Writes 3 Lines of Code That Fixes Everything
Building In Public: From Bedroom Hackathon to Million-User Scale

visualStyling.lighting: High-contrast dark mode neon rim lighting, glowing mechanical keyboard reflections, matrix green on obsidian black
visualStyling.colorPalette: Zinc 950, electric emerald, cyan accent, muted slate
visualStyling.framing: Fast macro rack-focuses onto terminal cursors, dynamic camera sweeps over server racks, split-screen micro-actions

branchingStructure.option1: The High-Stakes Incident (Suspenseful incident response turning into triumphant resolution)
branchingStructure.option2: The Deadpan Parody (Satirical contrast of bloated legacy enterprise tools)
branchingStructure.option3: The Kinetic Speedrun (High-cadence hacker montage synced to synthwave beats)

defaultTaglineFormat: Engineered for builders who hate wasting keystrokes.
